Indexer against scripts/chain-scan.mjs on the new positions: the indexer had not synced since 2026-11-14T07:33:34.969Z (at block 16771045/16771046, chain scan to 16773266), so the two could not be equal and the check was not run this time. The pages were compared with the indexer's own /stats instead. At block 16755791/16756229 the indexer and the scan were equal on every field (see docs/ui-pass-v3.md).
The 'team wallets' label going away: no wallet outside the team has used the contracts yet, so the branch that drops the label only has a unit test (lib/team.test.ts), not a browser run.
